a:

actually, we are used to express XXXXX as plural. we can use XXXXX as a noun (but we usually not because "XXXXX" is a verb, so we want to say "the XXXXX is now"). the plural is XXXXX. if we want to use XXXXX in english, we use "XXXXX" as an adjective.
there's nothing wrong with the word "XXXXX" as a noun. you can also be pretty sure that the word "XXXXX" is used in english like that.
